retainedIntent: Local interference depends on live emitter location/radius and the affected side; moving out, disabling, death/deletion should remove the effect.

sourceProblems: The player-only disable routine explicitly refuses nonplayers, so the supplied script does not deny CBE AI reporting/reinforcement through its logical communication path.

Every machine starts a perpetual scanner; sleep1 is inside the enabled branch, so a disabled master can busy-loop. Disabling does not restore already affected players and ongoing UAV loops do not read the master switch.
Any radar/name match is treated as an EW emitter. Side inequality is not hostility/selection policy. Global vehicle/unit scans multiply per radar.

Player TFAR/ACRE variables and chat/channel/audio changes have no demonstrated API/effect/restoration proof; the registered voice-chat flag is not consumed by the effect path. Baselines/restoration depend on later toggles rather than exact applied ownership.

UAV workers disable captured crew AI flags, force velocity/attitude/engine state and later blanket-enable flags without original state or current-owner/task receipts. No forced crash or blanket restoration imported.
